meta.title: Tab Mode & Model Switcher
meta.description: Switch between Plan and Build modes with Tab key or button like Claude Code, automatically remembering the model selected in each mode.

button.planAria: Plan mode on, press to switch to Build mode
button.buildAria: Build mode on, press to switch to Plan mode
button.planTitle: Plan mode on · Click or press Tab to switch to Build mode (use the model selector on the right to set this mode's model)
button.buildTitle: Build mode on · Click or press Tab to switch to Plan mode (use the model selector on the right to set this mode's model)
